answer: The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, capped per identity per epoch, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. A crystal of per-task receipts records who did what, and the whisper of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. What survives to the shale is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
